description:
THE BEAT by Allen Parr YouTube channel made a video entitled, "I Was WRONG, WRONG, WRONG About Seventh-Day Adventism - Part 1" where he called the Investigative Judgment the biggest heresy in the Seventh-day Adventist Church. In this video, I will explore the Bible to see whether or not Scripture supports the Investigative Judgment. The truth will surprise you!
